dependency_barriers.read_only_first: M1-U002 may inspect and hash source bytes but may not copy, transform, execute, or admit them.
dependency_barriers.rights_before_readiness: M1-U003 requires an explicit owner/rightsholder response for the exact hash-bound project-authored artifacts because current evidence is ambiguous. Stop and ask before this human-gated unit. It must produce a structurally valid source gate that is ready, or blocked solely by affirmative failure, explicit owner refusal, or definitive exclusion. Unknown, stale, missing, ambiguous, or deferred evidence cannot advance.
dependency_barriers.readiness_before_copy: M1-U004 audits the exact candidate only after the source gate is ready or blocked by affirmative failure, explicit owner refusal, or definitive exclusion. Unknown, stale, missing, ambiguous, or deferred evidence remains at the human stop and cannot advance. Only a dataset-readiness pass can permit copying; a definitive blocked source gate must remain nonpass and flow to a zero-copy disposition.
dependency_barriers.copy_boundary: M1-U005 may copy only gate-approved identities into C:\Projects\Active\burnlens-experiment-three-custody when both decisions pass. Otherwise it may only write the required machine-readable zero-admission manifest and receipt. It may not commit or redistribute third-party bytes unless the source gate explicitly approves that separate action.
dependency_barriers.resolved_no_intake: An affirmative rights failure, explicit owner refusal, definitive source exclusion, or nonpass readiness decision based on complete evidence is an honest resolved outcome. The dependency chain remains U003 to U004 to U005: U004 records the nonpass readiness disposition and U005 records zero admitted bytes. Unknown, stale, missing, ambiguous, or deferred rights evidence is not a no-intake decision and remains a human stop.
dependency_barriers.no_training_authority: A source-gate or readiness pass creates no training, model, inference, evaluation, publication, or fresh-evidence authority in Milestone 1.
